question: three-js-3d-game
prompt: Create a three.js 3D game where I can place buildings of various designs and sizes, and drive through the town I’ve created. Add traffic to the road as well. In a single-page self-container HTML.
content:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <title>3D City Builder & Driver</title>
    <style>body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; } canvas { display: block; }</style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
    import * as THREE from 'https://unpkg.com/three@0.158.0/build/three.module.js';

    // Scene Setup
    const scene = new THREE.Scene();
    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87ceeb);
    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({antialias: true});
    renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
    light.position.set(5, 10, 5);
    scene.add(light, new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040));

    // Ground
    const plane = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: 0x333333}));
    plane.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
    scene.add(plane);

    // Car
    const car = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 0.5, 2), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: 0xff0000}));
    car.position.y = 0.25;
    scene.add(car);

    // Traffic
    const traffic = [];
    for(let i=0; i<5; i++) {
        const t = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 0.5, 1.5), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: 0xffff00}));
        t.position.set(Math.random()*20-10, 0.25, Math.random()*20-10);
        scene.add(t);
        traffic.push(t);
    }

    // Controls & Input
    const keys = {};
    window.addEventListener('keydown', (e) => keys[e.code] = true);
    window.addEventListener('keyup', (e) => keys[e.code] = false);

    // Placement
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();
    window.addEventListener('mousedown', (e) => {
        mouse.x = (e.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
        mouse.y = -(e.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
        raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
        const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(plane);
        if (intersects.length > 0) {
            const size = Math.random() * 2 + 1;
            const b = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(size, size*2, size), new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({color: Math.random()*0xffffff}));
            b.position.set(intersects[0].point.x, size, intersects[0].point.z);
            scene.add(b);
        }
    });

    // Loop
    function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);
        
        // Drive controls
        if(keys['KeyW']) car.translateZ(0.2);
        if(keys['KeyS']) car.translateZ(-0.2);
        if(keys['KeyA']) car.rotation.y += 0.05;
        if(keys['KeyD']) car.rotation.y -= 0.05;

        // Follow Camera
        camera.position.x = car.position.x + Math.sin(car.rotation.y) * 10;
        camera.position.z = car.position.z + Math.cos(car.rotation.y) * 10;
        camera.position.y = 5;
        camera.lookAt(car.position);

        // Move Traffic
        traffic.forEach(t => {
            t.translateZ(0.05);
            if(t.position.length() > 50) t.position.set(0, 0.25, 0);
        });

        renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }
    animate();
</script>
</body>
</html>

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xa0d0ff);

const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(60, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
camera.position.set(0, 20, 30);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias:true });
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);

const hemi = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xffffff, 0x444444, 1.2);
hemi.position.set(0, 20, 0);
scene.add(hemi);

dirLight.position.set(-3, 10, -10);
scene.add(dirLight);

const groundMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x555555 });
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI/2;
ground.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(ground);

const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

  mouse.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
  raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
  const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(ground);
  if (intersects.length > 0) {
    const point = intersects[0].point;
    addBuilding(point);
  }
}
window.addEventListener('click', onMouseClick, false);

/* ---------- Building Creation ---------- */
function addBuilding(position) {
  const width = THREE.MathUtils.randFloat(3, 8);
  const depth = THREE.MathUtils.randFloat(3, 8);
  const height = THREE.MathUtils.randFloat(5, 20);
  const geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, depth);
  const mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x8b4513 });
  const building = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
  building.position.set(position.x, height/2, position.z);
  building.castShadow = true;
  scene.add(building);
}

const carMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
const car = new THREE.Mesh(carGeo, carMat);
car.position.set(0, 0.5, 0);
car.castShadow = true;
scene.add(car);

/* ---------- Traffic Cars ---------- */

scene.add(trafficGroup);
const trafficCars = [];

  const tGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 4);
  const tMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x0000ff });
  const tCar = new THREE.Mesh(tGeo, tMat);
  tCar.position.set(-10 + i*5, 0.5, -5);
  tCar.castShadow = true;
  trafficGroup.add(tCar);
  trafficCars.push(tCar);

/* ---------- Path for cars ---------- */

  new THREE.Vector3(-20, 0, 0),
  new THREE.Vector3(-10, 0, 0),
  new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 0),
  new THREE.Vector3(10, 0, 0),
  new THREE.Vector3(20, 0, 0)
];
const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(pathPoints);
curve.closed = true;

/* ---------- Animation ---------- */
let t = 0; // parameter for car along the curve

function animate() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animate);
  controls.update();

  // Move our car forward
  t = (t + 0.01) % 1;
  const carPos = curve.getPointAt(t);
  const carTangent = curve.getTangentAt(t);
  car.position.copy(carPos);
  car.position.y += 0.5; // keep above ground
  const axis = new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0);
  const angle = Math.atan2(carTangent.z, carTangent.x);
  car.rotation.set(0, angle, 0);

  // Move traffic cars in opposite direction
  trafficCars.forEach((tCar, idx) => {
    const tt = (t + 0.5 + idx*0.1) % 1; // offset each car
    const pos = curve.getPointAt(tt);
    tCar.position.copy(pos);
    tCar.position.y += 0.5;
    const tan = curve.getTangentAt(tt);
    const ang = Math.atan2(tan.z, tan.x);
    tCar.rotation.set(0, ang, 0);
  });

  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}
animate();

/* ---------- Resize handling ---------- */
window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
  camera.aspect = window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight;
  camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
  renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
});
</script>

    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/build/three.min.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.155.0/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script>
        // Scene setup
        const scene = new THREE.Scene();
        const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth/window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
        const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        // Lighting
        const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
        light.position.set(5, 5, 5);
        scene.add(light);

        // Ground
        const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100);
        const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0x88ccff });
        const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
        ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        scene.add(ground);

        // Building system
        const buildings = [];
        const buildingTypes = [
            { name: "Cube", geometry: new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 3, 2), color: 0x88ccff },
            { name: "Pyramid", geometry: new THREE.IcosahedronGeometry(2, 0), color: 0xff4444 },
            { name: "Cylinder", geometry: new THREE.CylinderGeometry(1, 1.5, 3, 32), color: 0x44aa44 }
        ];

        function addBuilding(position) {
            const type = buildingTypes[Math.floor(Math.random() * buildingTypes.length)];
            const geometry = type.geometry;
            const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: type.color });
            const building = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            building.position.set(position.x, position.y, position.z);
            scene.add(building);
            buildings.push(building);
        }

        // Raycaster for building placement
        const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
        const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

        window.addEventListener('mousedown', () => {
            mouse.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
            mouse.y = - (event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;
            raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
            const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(scene.children);
            if (intersects.length > 0) {
                addBuilding(intersects[0].point);
            }
        });

        // Car system
        const carGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 3);
        const carMaterial = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
        const car = new THREE.Mesh(carGeometry, carMaterial);
        car.position.set(0, 0.5, 0);
        scene.add(car);

        let carSpeed = 0.1;
        let carDirection = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0, 1);

        document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
            if (event.key === 'w') carDirection.z += 0.1;
            if (event.key === 's') carDirection.z -= 0.1;
            if (event.key === 'a') carDirection.x -= 0.1;
            if (event.key === 'd') carDirection.x += 0.1;
        });

        // Normalize direction
        function normalizeVector(v) {
            const length = Math.sqrt(v.x*v.x + v.y*v.y + v.z*v.z);
            if (length > 0) v.divideScalar(length);
        }

        // Traffic system
        const trafficCars = [];
        for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
            const trafficCar = new THREE.Mesh(carGeometry, carMaterial);
            trafficCar.position.set(i * 5, 0.5, 0);
            scene.add(trafficCar);
            trafficCars.push(trafficCar);
        }

        // Animation loop
        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);
            renderer.render(scene, camera);

            // Update car
            normalizeVector(carDirection);
            car.position.add(carDirection.multiplyScalar(carSpeed));

            // Update traffic
            for (let car of trafficCars) {
                car.position.x += 0.05;
                if (car.position.x > 50) car.position.x = -50;
            }
        }

        animate();

        // Camera controls
        const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
    </script>

    <script>
      // Set up scene, camera, and renderer
      var scene = new THREE.Scene();
      scene.fog = new THREE.Fog(0xa0a0a0, 10, 1000);

      var camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(
        75,
        window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight,
        0.1,
        1000
      );

      var renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

      // Add lights to the scene
      var ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
      scene.add(ambientLight);

      var directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.6);
      directionalLight.position.set(100, 100, 100);
      scene.add(directionalLight);

      // Create a large ground plane (the “land”)
      var groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1000, 1000);
      // Use a dark material so the road stands out
      var groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x444444 });
      var ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
      ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      scene.add(ground);

      // Create a road along the center (horizontal along z = 0)
      var roadWidth = 10;
      var roadMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x333333 });
      var road = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.PlaneGeometry(1000, roadWidth), roadMaterial);
      road.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
      road.position.z = 0;
      scene.add(road);

      // Generate Buildings Along the Road’s Sides (different sizes and colors)
      var buildings = [];

      // Right side of the road (positive z)
      for (var i = -500; i < 500; i += 50) {
        var bWidth = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
        var bDepth = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
        var bHeight = 50 + Math.random() * 150;
        var buildingGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(bWidth, bHeight, bDepth);
        var buildingMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: Math.random() * 0xffffff });
        var building = new THREE.Mesh(buildingGeo, buildingMat);
        // Place it so its front touches the road walkway area at a small gap (5 units)
        building.position.set(i, bHeight / 2, roadWidth / 2 + bDepth / 2 + 5);
        scene.add(building);
        buildings.push(building);
      }

      // Left side of the road (negative z)
      for (var i = -500; i < 500; i += 50) {
        var bWidth = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
        var bDepth = 30 + Math.random() * 20;
        var bHeight = 50 + Math.random() * 150;
        var buildingGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(bWidth, bHeight, bDepth);
        var buildingMat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: Math.random() * 0xffffff });
        var building = new THREE.Mesh(buildingGeo, buildingMat);
        building.position.set(i, bHeight / 2, -roadWidth / 2 - bDepth / 2 - 5);
        scene.add(building);
        buildings.push(building);
      }

      // Additional buildings in the distant “downtown”
      for (var x = -400; x <= 400; x += 100) {
        for (var z = 20; z <= 400; z += 100) {
          var wb = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
          var db = 30 + Math.random() * 40;
          var hb = 50 + Math.random() * 200;
          var geo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(wb, hb, db);
          var mat = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: Math.random() * 0xffffff });
          var bld = new THREE.Mesh(geo, mat);
          bld.position.set(x, hb / 2, z);
          scene.add(bld);
          buildings.push(bld);
        }
      }

      // Create the player’s car (a red box)
      var carGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(4, 1.5, 2);
      var carMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
      var car = new THREE.Mesh(carGeometry, carMaterial);
      // start a little back from the center
      car.position.set(0, 0.75, -20);
      scene.add(car);

      // Attach the camera to the car so it follows (simulate a chase cam)
      var carCamera = new THREE.Object3D();
      carCamera.position.set(0, 5, -10); // camera offset relative to the car
      car.add(carCamera);
      // Set the camera’s position to 0 since it’s relative to the car now
      camera.position.set(0, 0, 0);
      car.add(camera);

      // Create some traffic cars that will drive along the main road (blue boxes)
      var trafficCars = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
        var tCarGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(4, 1.5, 2);
        var tCarMaterial = new THREE.MeshLambertMaterial({ color: 0x0000ff });
        var tCar = new THREE.Mesh(tCarGeometry, tCarMaterial);
        // Randomize starting x-position along the road
        tCar.position.set(-500 + Math.random() * 1000, 0.75, 0);
        // Each traffic car moves horizontally. Hold its speed and direction in userData.
        tCar.userData = {
          speed: 0.5 + Math.random() * 1.0,
          direction: Math.random() > 0.5 ? 1 : -1,
        };
        scene.add(tCar);
        trafficCars.push(tCar);
      }

      // Set up keyboard controls for the player car
      var keys = {};
      window.addEventListener('keydown', function (e) {
        keys[e.code] = true;
      });
      window.addEventListener('keyup', function (e) {
        keys[e.code] = false;
      });

      // Car movement parameters
      var speed = 0;
      var maxSpeed = 2;
      var acceleration = 0.05;
      var deceleration = 0.03;
      var turnSpeed = 0.03;

      function animate() {
        requestAnimationFrame(animate);

        // Player car controls (W/Up arrow to accelerate, S/Down to brake, A/Left and D/Right to turn)
        if (keys['ArrowUp'] || keys['KeyW']) {
          speed += acceleration;
          if (speed > maxSpeed) speed = maxSpeed;
        } else if (keys['ArrowDown'] || keys['KeyS']) {
          speed -= acceleration;
          if (speed < -maxSpeed / 2) speed = -maxSpeed / 2;
        } else {
          // Natural deceleration if no acceleration key is pressed
          if (speed > 0) {
            speed -= deceleration;
            if (speed < 0) speed = 0;
          } else if (speed < 0) {
            speed += deceleration;
            if (speed > 0) speed = 0;
          }
        }

        if (keys['ArrowLeft'] || keys['KeyA']) {
          car.rotation.y += turnSpeed;
        }
        if (keys['ArrowRight'] || keys['KeyD']) {
          car.rotation.y -= turnSpeed;
        }

        // Update the car’s position based on its forward direction
        car.position.x -= Math.sin(car.rotation.y) * speed;
        car.position.z -= Math.cos(car.rotation.y) * speed;

        // Make the traffic cars move along the road in their set direction
        trafficCars.forEach(function (tCar) {
          tCar.position.x += tCar.userData.speed * tCar.userData.direction;
          // Loop around when off the road
          if (tCar.position.x > 500) tCar.position.x = -500;
          if (tCar.position.x < -500) tCar.position.x = 500;
        });

        renderer.render(scene, camera);
      }
      animate();

      // Handle resizing of the window
      window.addEventListener('resize', function () {
        camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      });

    scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xaaaaaa);

    const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
    camera.position.set(0, 10, 20);

    const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });

    // Lighting
    const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
    light.position.set(5, 10, 7.5);

    const ambient = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040);
    scene.add(ambient);

    // Ground
    const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100);
    const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x222222 });
    const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
    ground.rotation.y = -Math.PI / 2; // Rotate to lie on XZ plane
    scene.add(ground);

    // Controls
    const controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
    controls.target.set(0, 0, 0);
    controls.update();

    // Building placement
    const raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
    const mouse = new THREE.Vector2();

    window.addEventListener('click', (event) => {
      mouse.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
      mouse.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;

      raycaster.setFromCamera(mouse, camera);
      const intersects = raycaster.intersectObject(ground);
      if (intersects.length > 0) {
        const point = intersects[0].point;
        createBuilding(point.x, point.z);
      }
    });

    function createBuilding(x, z) {
      const height = Math.random() * 10 + 5;
      const width = Math.random() * 5 + 2;
      const depth = Math.random() * 5 + 2;
      const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, depth);
      const material = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: Math.random() * 0xffffff });
      const building = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
      building.position.set(x, height / 2, z);
      scene.add(building);
    }

    // Car setup
    const carGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 1);
    const carMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
    const car = new THREE.Mesh(carGeometry, carMaterial);
    car.position.set(0, 0.5, 0);
    scene.add(car);

    // Traffic cars
    const trafficCars = [];
    for (let i = 0; i < 5; i++) {
      const trafficCar = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 0.5, 0.5), new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x00ff00 }));
      trafficCar.position.set(Math.random() * 20 - 10, 0.25, Math.random() * 20 - 10);
      scene.add(trafficCar);
      trafficCars.push(trafficCar);
    }

    // Keyboard controls for car
    const keys = { w: false, a: false, s: false, d: false };

    document.addEventListener('keydown', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'w') keys.w = true;
      if (event.key === 'a') keys.a = true;
      if (event.key === 's') keys.s = true;
      if (event.key === 'd') keys.d = true;
    });

    document.addEventListener('keyup', (event) => {
      if (event.key === 'w') keys.w = false;
      if (event.key === 'a') keys.a = false;
      if (event.key === 's') keys.s = false;
      if (event.key === 'd') keys.d = false;
    });

    // Animation loop
    function animate() {
      requestAnimationFrame(animate);

      // Car movement
      const speed = 0.1;
      if (keys.w) car.position.z -= speed;
      if (keys.s) car.position.z += speed;
      if (keys.a) car.position.x -= speed;
      if (keys.d) car.position.x += speed;

      // Traffic cars movement
      const trafficSpeed = 0.01;
      trafficCars.forEach((car, index) => {
        const direction = (index % 2 === 0) ? 1 : -1;
        car.position.x += direction * trafficSpeed;
        if (Math.abs(car.position.x) > 10) {
          car.position.x = Math.sign(car.position.x) * 10;
        }
      });

      renderer.render(scene, camera);
    }

    animate();

    // Handle window resize
    window.addEventListener('resize', () => {
      camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
      camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
      renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
    });

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
  <head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8" />
    <title>three.js webgl - interactive cubes</title>
    <style>
      body {
        margin: 0;
        overflow: hidden;
      }
    </style>

  <body>
    <script type="importmap">
      {
        "imports": {
          "three": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.176.0/build/three.module.js",
          "three/addons/": "https://unpkg.com/three@0.176.0/examples/jsm/"
        }
      }
    </script>

    <script type="module">
      import * as THREE from "three";

      import { OrbitControls } from "three/addons/controls/OrbitControls.js";
      import { GLTFLoader } from "three/addons/loaders/GLTFLoader.js";

      let camera, scene, renderer;
      let controls;
      let raycaster, pointer;
      let objects = [];
      let car;
      let road;
      let buildings = [];
      let trafficCars = [];
      let isPlacingBuilding = false;
      let currentBuildingType = "house";
      let buildingSize = 1;

      init();

      function init() {
        camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(70, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 100);
        camera.position.set(0, 5, 10);

        scene = new THREE.Scene();
        scene.background = new THREE.Color(0x87CEEB); // Sky blue background

        // Lighting
        const ambientLight = new THREE.AmbientLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
        scene.add(ambientLight);

        const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.8);
        directionalLight.position.set(1, 1, 1);
        scene.add(directionalLight);

        // Ground (Road)
        const roadGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(20, 40);
        const roadMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x333333 });
        road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeometry, roadMaterial);
        road.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
        road.position.y = -0.01; // Slightly below ground
        scene.add(road);

        // Sidewalk
        const sidewalkGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(22, 0.5, 42);
        const sidewalkMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x999999 });
        const sidewalk = new THREE.Mesh(sidewalkGeometry, sidewalkMaterial);
        sidewalk.position.y = -0.25;
        scene.add(sidewalk);

        // Car (Player)
        const carGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1.5, 0.7, 3);
        const carMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
        car = new THREE.Mesh(carGeometry, carMaterial);
        car.position.set(0, 0.5, -10);
        scene.add(car);

        // Add some initial buildings
        addBuilding("house", 3, 0, 5);
        addBuilding("tower", 1, -5, 5);
        addBuilding("house", 2, 5, 5);

        // Add traffic cars
        addTrafficCar(-8, 0.5, 5);
        addTrafficCar(8, 0.5, -5);

        renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({ antialias: true });
        renderer.setPixelRatio(window.devicePixelRatio);
        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        renderer.setAnimationLoop(animate);
        document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

        controls = new OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
        controls.enableDamping = true;
        controls.dampingFactor = 0.05;

        raycaster = new THREE.Raycaster();
        pointer = new THREE.Vector2();

        window.addEventListener("pointerdown", onPointerDown);
        window.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown);
        window.addEventListener("resize", onWindowResize);
      }

      function onWindowResize() {
        camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
        camera.updateProjectionMatrix();

        renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
      }

      function onPointerDown(event) {
        pointer.x = (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1;
        pointer.y = -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1;

        raycaster.setFromCamera(pointer, camera);

        const intersects = raycaster.intersectObjects(scene.children);

        if (intersects.length > 0) {
          const object = intersects[0].object;

          if (object === road && isPlacingBuilding) {
            // Calculate position on road (snap to grid)
            const mouse = new THREE.Vector3(
              (event.clientX / window.innerWidth) * 2 - 1,
              -(event.clientY / window.innerHeight) * 2 + 1,
              0.5,
            );
            mouse.unproject(camera);

            const dir = mouse.sub(camera.position).normalize();
            const distance = -camera.position.y / dir.y;
            const pos = camera.position.clone().add(dir.multiplyScalar(distance));

            // Snap to grid (every 2 units)
            const snappedX = Math.round(pos.x / 2) * 2;
            const snappedZ = Math.round(pos.z / 2) * 2;

            addBuilding(currentBuildingType, buildingSize, snappedX, snappedZ);
          }
        }
      }

      function onKeyDown(event) {
        switch (event.key) {
          case "1":
            currentBuildingType = "house";
            buildingSize = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 2); // Random size between 1-2
            break;
          case "2":
            currentBuildingType = "tower";
            buildingSize = 1 + Math.floor(Math.random() * 3); // Random size between 1-3
            break;
          case "b":
            isPlacingBuilding = !isPlacingBuilding;
            if (isPlacingBuilding) {
              console.log("Building mode ON. Press 1 for houses, 2 for towers.");
            } else {
              console.log("Building mode OFF.");
            }
            break;
          case "ArrowUp":
            car.position.z -= 0.2;
            break;
          case "ArrowDown":
            car.position.z += 0.2;
            break;
          case "ArrowLeft":
            car.position.x -= 0.2;
            break;
          case "ArrowRight":
            car.position.x += 0.2;
            break;
        }

        // Keep car on road (simple boundary check)
        car.position.x = Math.max(-9, Math.min(9, car.position.x));
        car.position.z = Math.max(-19, Math.min(19, car.position.z));
      }

      function addBuilding(type, size, x, z) {
        let geometry, material;

        if (type === "house") {
          // Simple house geometry
          const houseGeometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(size * 1.5, size * 1.5, size * 1.5);
          const roofGeometry = new THREE.ConeGeometry(size * 1.8, size * 0.8, 4);
          roofGeometry.position.y = size * 0.75 + size * 0.4; // Move roof on top of house

          const houseMaterial = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8B4513 }); // Brown

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0"/>
  <title>3D Town Builder & Drive</title>
  <style>
    body { margin: 0; overflow: hidden; }
    canvas { display: block; }
  </style>
</head>
<body>
<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/three@0.132.2/build/three.module.js';

// Scene setup
const scene = new THREE.Scene();
const camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

// Lights
const light = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 1);
light.position.set(5, 10, 5);
scene.add(light);

// Ground
const groundGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100);
const groundMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x8b8b8b });
const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeo, groundMat);
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
ground.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(ground);

// Road geometry (simple rectangular road)
const roadGeo = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(30, 10);
const roadMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0x333333 });
const road = new THREE.Mesh(roadGeo, roadMat);
road.position.set(0, 0, 0);
road.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
road.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(road);

// Building function
function addBuilding(x, y, z, width, height, depth, type) {
  const buildingGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(width, height, depth);
  const buildingMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: type === 'residential' ? 0x9cb3a0 : 0x704030 });
  const building = new THREE.Mesh(buildingGeo, buildingMat);
  building.position.set(x, y, z);
  building.castShadow = true;
  scene.add(building);

  // Simple traffic light placeholder (optional)
  if (type === 'intersection') {
    const lightGeo = new THREE.CylinderGeometry(0.2, 0.2, 0.5, 32);
    const lightMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
    const light = new THREE.Mesh(lightGeo, lightMat);
    light.position.set(x, y + height/2, z);
    light.castShadow = false;
    scene.add(light);
  }
}

// Place sample buildings
addBuilding(-15, 0.5, -5, 4, 6, 4, 'residential');
addBuilding(-5, 0.5, -5, 6, 8, 6, 'commercial');
addBuilding(5, 0.5, -5, 4, 6, 4, 'residential');
addBuilding(-10, 0.5, 0, 4, 5, 4, 'intersection'); // intersection with traffic
addBuilding(10, 0.5, 0, 4, 5, 4, 'intersection');

// Vehicle (simple cube)
let carPosition = new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.5, -20);
const carGeo = new THREE.BoxGeometry(2, 1, 4);
const carMat = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xff0000 });
const car = new THREE.Mesh(carGeo, carMat);
car.position.set(carPosition.x, carPosition.y, carPosition.z);
car.castShadow = true;
scene.add(car);

// Camera position
camera.position.set(0, 10, 30);
camera.lookAt(0, 0, 0);

// Simple traffic simulation (cars moving along road)
function animateTraffic() {
  requestAnimationFrame(animateTraffic);
  
  // Move cars forward along X-axis
  carPosition.x += 0.1;
  if (carPosition.x > 20) carPosition.x = -20; // Loop
  car.position.copy(carPosition);
  
  // Random small traffic variation
  const noise = Math.random() * 0.5 - 0.25;
  carPosition.z += noise * 0.05;
  if (carPosition.z > 10 || carPosition.z < -10) carPosition.z = 0;
  
  renderer.render(scene, camera);
}

<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
    <meta charset="UTF-8">
    <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
    <title>3D Town Game</title>
    <style>
        body { margin: 0; }
        canvas { display: block; }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <script src="https://threejs.org/build/three.js"></script>
    <script src="https://threejs.org/examples/js/controls/OrbitControls.js"></script>
    <script src="https://cdnjs.cloudflare.com/ajax/libs/dat-gui/0.7.6/dat.gui.min.js"></script>
    <script>
        let scene, camera, renderer, controls;
        let vehicle, clock = new THREE.Clock();

        function init() {
            scene = new THREE.Scene();
            camera = new THREE.PerspectiveCamera(75, window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight, 0.1, 1000);
            camera.position.set(5, 10, 20);

            renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
            document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

            controls = new THREE.OrbitControls(camera, renderer.domElement);
            controls.target.set(0, 5, 0);

            const light = new THREE.AmbientLight(0x404040); // soft white light
            scene.add(light);

            const directionalLight = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xffffff, 0.5);
            scene.add(directionalLight);

            // Ground
            const groundGeometry = new THREE.PlaneGeometry(100, 100);
            const groundMaterial = new THREE.MeshPhongMaterial({color: 0x999999, depthWrite: false});
            const ground = new THREE.Mesh(groundGeometry, groundMaterial);
            ground.rotation.x = - Math.PI / 2;
            scene.add(ground);

            addBuildings();
            addVehicle();

            animate();
        }

        function addBuildings() {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 3, 1);
            const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0x00ff00});
            for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
                const building = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
                building.position.set(Math.random() * 50 - 25, 1.5, Math.random() * 50 - 25);
                scene.add(building);
            }
        }

        function addVehicle() {
            const geometry = new THREE.BoxGeometry(1, 1, 2);
            const material = new THREE.MeshBasicMaterial({color: 0xff0000});
            vehicle = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
            vehicle.position.y = 1;
            scene.add(vehicle);
        }

        function animate() {
            requestAnimationFrame(animate);

            const delta = clock.getDelta(); // seconds.
            vehicle.position.x += delta * 5; // Move along x-axis

            controls.update();
            renderer.render(scene, camera);
        }

        window.addEventListener('resize', onWindowResize, false);

        function onWindowResize() {
            camera.aspect = window.innerWidth / window.innerHeight;
            camera.updateProjectionMatrix();
            renderer.setSize(window.innerWidth, window.innerHeight);
        }

        init();
    </script>
</body>
</html>
